verdict.rationale: Box's own marketing says users can "access, share, edit, and co-create content", a first-party claim of in-place editing and co-creation, but it is only a generic one-liner. The preview-and-annotate capability is adjacent (review, not editing) and earns no credit. Missing for 10: documented real-time browser co-editing of docs/sheets/slides, a named native editor or documented Office/Google integration, any detail on concurrent editing, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
